name: unfollowers-for-instagram
description: Identify accounts you follow that don't follow you back. 100% private, client-side, zero login required.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --loader:.svg=text --loader:.css=text --minify --outfile=dist/index.min.js && node scripts/update-html.js
scripts.package:extension: npm run build && node scripts/create-extension-icons.js && npm run package:source && (cd extension && zip -q -r ../extension.zip . -x extension.zip)
